provenance.scientific_status: HAMILTONIAN_CHESS_V0 executability run. The evaluator is a deterministic stub with no reasoning ability and the arena has horizon 1; no number here is a scientific result or an evidence-ladder claim.

schema_divergences: Spec section 4 puts the index in new SQLite tables in arena/storage/db.py. This module writes only the content-addressed payload half; arena/storage/db.py is unchanged, so the database is not yet the index and the queries of spec section 5 are directory scans.

Spec section 3.10 stores failure modes as rows with counts, severities and exemplars over the FailureClass / RowStatus vocabulary. V0's offline path has no Solver and therefore no solver-caused failure classes; failure_modes is a tuple of loop-level class names.

Spec sections 3.4 and 3.9 require trajectory fields (trajectory_mode, risk_set_by_depth, beta_hat, hazard_by_depth). No trajectory world exists, so those fields are absent rather than filled with placeholders.

Spec section 3.11 requires the full GateZeroEvidence, FrozenAdversaries and ParityReport field sets per gate. GateOutcome.evidence carries what the V0 gates actually computed and no more; an unmeasured gate field is absent, never defaulted.

Proposal bookkeeping (BOOKKEEPING_FIELDS: proposal_id, mutation_hash, created_at, wall_clock_seconds) is stored but is covered by no hash. That is the RT-13 fix and it is a real trade: those four fields are editable in place without detection. They are labels, not measurements - the semantic content of the mutation is covered by the derived MutationDescriptor.intervention_hash, which is inside content_hash.
